note: At the head of Lake Francis where the Connecticut River comes in, in the Great North Woods. The hookup sites 13-18 line the shore. Sites 1-4, 20, 21 and 44-46 are ATV-accessible, with trails into Coos County's OHRV network. Limited cell service. --Claude
summary: Park page + RA per-site read + 2026 operating schedule: 45 sites, 20-amp water/electric on 13-21 (+043), 15 units take 23 ft+ (8 at 40 ft), $35/$45 confirmed, showers/flush/dump/laundry, season 5/10-10/24 (2026). Lakefront confirmed: RA tags 13-18 Lakefront (27-40 ft) and they sit ~15-25 m from the shore. Pin within ~60 m. Note rewritten.
flags: Waterfront lakefront confirmed: RA tags sites 013-019 and 043 'Lakefront'; the RV-capable ones are 013 (45.05862,-71.30202, 40 ft), 014 (27 ft), 015 (40 ft), 016 (45.05912,-71.30180, 40 ft), 017 and 018 (27 ft). On Esri imagery they sit about 15-25 m from the high-water line of the lake's upper basin (~350 m wide) across open grass and scattered trees; the bank is low and gentle, below it a light drawdown strip. Sites are sold by the night through RA.

OHV (flag only, general campground with an OHV side): the park page says 'With added ATV camping sites, riders are able to leave their campsite and head right out on the trails. Trails from Lake Francis State Park connect with the 1000 mile of trails for OHRV riding in Coos County.' RA: 'ATV ACCESSIBLE SITES: Sites 1, 2, 3, 4 20, 21, 44, 45 and 46.' Nine of 45 sites; the campground is otherwise a lakeside state park campground, not a staging area.
Rig length: 15 RA units take 23 ft+ (40 ft on 8). Not a placeholder (values range 10-40).

Season: the info sheet (rev 4/2019) says 'Memorial Day weekend through Veterans Day'; the 2026 schedule says 5/10 to 10/24 and the park page 'Closed 10/24' - the 2026 schedule is written. RA's 2027 'Peak' season is May 28 to October 10, 2027 (reservation season, not written).
Pin 45.05972,-71.30278 is ~60 m west of the site centre (45.0598,-71.3021); no move needed.
Phone 603-538-6965 matches the park page. Website unchanged. RA header carries a typo 'Park office phone number - 603-538-69659'.
